reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on their #central-team message: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 June. It said Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a 7:10 driver's trailer number ended up on a sticky note. That message names the store but gives no site code or address. I couldn't find one in any channel Pree belongs to or in the public files either. I told Pree that if the sheet needs a code, it will have to come from Marrow's store ops or the rollout tracker.
